name: followup-pairs-v1
description: Synthetic two-turn pairs for follow-up queries. Subjects of the first ten are taken from benchmarks/entity_graph/fixtures-v1.jsonl and tests/fixtures/generation/v1.json; the rest, every follow-up turn and every distractor are authored. Splits alternate and were declared before any measurement. Measures the mechanism on a small corpus, not a real-world rate.
